note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: GDS (Wanguo Data) Zhongwei A-zone Phase 2 (万国数据中卫一体化绿色先进示范数据中心产业园A区二期项目), Xuanhe
entries.reason: Status is ready: construction-project planning permit 6405022026GG0075620 issued 30 September 2026 (published 10 October) to Ningxia Wanguo Shuwei Data Technology Co., Ltd., 193,908.83 m2 GFA, north half of the A-zone parcel (to Wanyun Road); land-use permit 6405022026YG0024667 (23 September). This fragment adds the A-zone as a new site with Phase 1, and only one project can be added to a site that is new in the same update.
entries.reopen_condition: In the next update after the A-zone site is published, add Phase 2 as a project on curated:gds-zhongwei-xuanhe-a-zone-campus reusing the published campus locator exactly (sources cn-ningxia-gansu-p1-gds-a2-gcxk and -gds-a2-board), unless a later Phase 2 status supersedes 30 September 2026.

entries.candidate: China Unicom plot north of planned Weisi Road, west of Sandang Highway (Xuanhe area, Zhongwei)
entries.reason: The 19 October 2026 Xuanhe infrastructure scheme labels three China Unicom gates (联通大门) on the north side of Weisi Road west of Sandang Highway, and the Xutao 330 kV EIA (Ningxia EEB acceptance 14 September 2026) reserves two 330 kV bays for 联通. No Zhongwei NRB planning notice or permit for a Unicom Xuanhe data centre appears in the lists to 10 October (permits) and 19 October (notices), so no dated status record names the project.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated primary record naming the China Unicom Xuanhe data-centre project (planning notice, permit, construction or operation); the block can then be located on the registered Xuanhe detailed plan (sources/research-countries-2026-10-22-cn-ningxia-gansu-p1-gds-xuanhe-a-zone-geometry-facts.json).

entries.candidate: Chindata (秦淮数据) Xuanhe load, Zhongwei data-centre cluster
entries.reason: The Xutao 330 kV substation EIA lists a far-term 330 kV outlet pair for 秦淮 among the Xuanhe data-centre loads (with 万国, 联通 and 移动). No Chindata planning record, site or dated status was found in the Zhongwei lists.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated primary record naming a Chindata Zhongwei/Xuanhe data-centre project and its parcel.

entries.candidate: China Unicom Ningxia Zhongwei Cloud Data Center main plot — No.5 data machine-room building adjustment (17 September 2026 pre-approval)
entries.reason: The 17 September 2026 NRB pre-approval notice for the existing China Unicom campus (133,398 m2 main plot) re-plans the No.5 data machine-room building from 30,337.9 to 33,963.31 m2 GFA. It is a scheme adjustment, not a permit, and the board shows a 已建 (built) general plan; whether No.5 is unbuilt, under construction or built is not established, so announced could understate a physical stage. A new project at the existing site would also need to reuse the existing campus locator.
entries.reopen_condition: An issued construction-project planning or construction permit for the adjusted No.5 building, or a dated construction/completion record, then add it as a project on curated:china-unicom-ningxia-zhongwei-cloud-data-center reusing the campus locator.

entries.candidate: Xutao 330 kV substation (宁夏徐套330千伏输变电工程) as power-readiness context for the Xuanhe data-centre cluster
entries.reason: Ningxia EEB accepted the EIA on 14 September 2026 (local nx-xutao-330kv-eia.pdf, nx-sl-nr-0914.html) and published a proposed approval on 13 October (nx-nscsp-nr-1013.html); the substation is built to supply about 1,150 MW of new Xuanhe cloud-computing load, with far-term 330 kV bays for 万国, 联通, 秦淮 and 移动, and the current phase 8 x 110 kV feeders to unnamed data centres. Grid context only; the approval decision was not yet published and the record does not tie a specific circuit to the China Mobile D07-D10 project.
entries.reopen_condition: The published EIA approval (or a grid-connection record naming the project), then attach as context_kind power_readiness with the existing status date preserved.

entries.candidate: Zhonglian Zero-Carbon Intelligent Computing (Xuanhe) Industrial Park — A-Zone (retained thirty-fourth hold)
entries.reason: Re-checked 22 October 2026: no planning or construction permit for A-zone buildings No.3/No.4 and no construction, completion or operation record after the 17 September pre-approval appears in the Zhongwei NRB, EEB or news lists; the Xutao 330 kV EIA mentions only the planned Tiandushan-Zhonglian Xuanhe 330 kV line. Its EIA substation point registers at the north-west corner of the block east of the Sandang Highway auxiliary road on the registered Xuanhe detailed plan, consistent with the prepared locator.
entries.reopen_condition: Unchanged from the thirty-fourth hold: a dated in-window primary record of the A-zone data-centre buildings' physical stage or an issued permit for them.

entries.candidate: Gansu Qingyang data-centre cluster (Xifeng District) — planning permits and EIA records
entries.reason: Not reachable without bypassing access controls on 22 October 2026: www.zgqingyang.gov.cn answers robots.txt with HTTP 403 (15,781-byte block page) and www.gsxf.gov.cn (Xifeng District) allows all in robots.txt but returns the same 403 block page for its homepage; the Gansu provincial portals sthj.gansu.gov.cn, fzgg.gansu.gov.cn, www.gansu.gov.cn and ggzyjy.gansu.gov.cn return HTTP 412 JavaScript challenges; zrzyt.gansu.gov.cn and www.xifeng.gov.cn did not resolve or connect; the Internet Archive CDX index returned HTTP 503 for the Qingyang domain; and the shared web-search budget was exhausted. No Qingyang candidate was examined.
entries.reopen_condition: A reachable official Qingyang/Xifeng or Gansu source (or a stated Internet Archive copy) with dated planning permits or EIA records naming a data-centre project and a coordinate or parcel; or an operator disclosure with a locatable site.
